headline: Grumpy Walrus opened a new CITY position at 12:17-12:19 PM ET (~11.75M CITY for ~754 ADA), about half an hour after that swarm launch, and kept rotating into NIGHT: ~100k SOLADA twice, 250k SNEK, 250k MEPE and 137 ASCEND swapped into NIGHT plus ~200 and ~100 ADA NIGHT buys (~7.6k NIGHT added). It also sold 250k SNEK for ~717 ADA and ~752k SOLADA for ~1.44k ADA. Net ADA ~+940 since 12:00 PM; ASCEND bag ~340.1k. CITY stays Pass (swarm launch, ~13.2k ADA pool side). COCK side ~145.9k, 2.7% under its line. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: a tracked whale buying a swarm launch half an hour in does not clean the swarm flags; CITY stays Pass, and the SW-01 test only asks whether that whale is still net-accumulating at launch+24h.
